profile.headline: Software Engineer at Best Buy Ads
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software engineer, who currently resides in the beautiful PNW. Music, food programming, design, and awesome humans align strongly with my personal values and ambitions. I love writing high-quality code that is maintainable, scalable, and innovative. 

I love taking on new challenges, solving problems, as well as learning something new!

If I'm not coding catch me hiking, traveling, finding live music, cooking, and eating delicious food! 

Feel free to get in touch, I’d love to chat (or grab a beer)
chaseklee990@gmail.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and implemented a business portal in React/Redux for increased reliability and scalability, while reducing page load times from ~15 seconds to less than 1 second. (Later presented to CEO Corie Bary)
• Developed a RESTful reporting APIs in Node.js that is responsible for driving the BestBuy Media Network.
• Worked closely with designers, product managers, and engineers to design and release new features.
• Created various Jenkins pipelines and improved unit and integration test coverage by 80%.
• Developed rapidly in an agile driven environment while participating in agile ceremonies daily.
• Created code documentation, performed peer code reviews, and conducted interviews for the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backed by Madrona Venture Group and London Venture Partners

• Created the app using React Native, collaborating closely with product and design teams to achieve 15,000+ installs, 300,000+ completed in-app games, and $20,000+ in ad revenue within six months.
• Designed, developed and deployed various microservices in Go using Docker, Kubernetes, Spinnaker, and AWS.
• Integrated AWS Kinesis and websockets in cahoots with mobile app for real time event processing.
• Set up CI/CD pipelines for continuous deployment to the iOS and Android app store using App Center.
• Refined legacy codebase for increased reliability, modularity, and stability.

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Assisted low-income and first generation high school students in attaining higher education
• Advised and mentored classes of 25+ students during the college application process
• Raised awareness among university students about the issues of educational opportunity and social mobility

The Seattle World School is a Seattle public school in Capitol Hill serving immigrants aged 10-21. The students come from over 20 different countries.The SWS helps students learn English and basic skills in addition to traditional high school classes.

• Tutored and worked closely with ESL students to develop their English languages.
• Helped organize and manage weekend school events such as clothing drives, culture fairs, and weekend education programs.

projects.title: aircasa
projects.description:
Airbnb clone application for users to browse and rent short-term lodging.

• Constructed front-end client with modular react components for reusability, increased readability, and scalability
• Integrated Google Maps API for real-time and dynamic map view rendering
• Designed an intuitive and dynamic UI using React, HTML5, & CSS for cross browser, platform, and screen size compatibility 
• Refined legacy codebase for increased readability, modularity, and stability

projects.title: slackcasa
projects.description:
Workspace collaboration tool to send and receive messages in real time.

• Implemented real time data transfer between multiple clients with native websockets (WSS), to reduce latency and increase scalability
• Architected websocket response object for efficient response object expectations between client & server
• Built modularized and reusable front-end components in React for optimized rendering speeds and efficient testing
• Designed PostgreSQL database schemas for optimal scalability

organizations.name: University of Washington Codepath iOS University
organizations.description:
• A Swift iOS coding class for students of all majors at the University of Washington (curriculum and projects from CodePath)
• Built apps resembling Twitter, Yelp, Instagram, and others
• Learned how to work with APIs, OAuth, and Parse Servers
• Developed teamwork skills by working on iOS applications

organizations.name: University of Washington Dream Project
organizations.description:
The mission of the University of Washington Dream Project is to assist low-income and first-generation high school students in attaining higher education and to raise awareness among university students about the issues of educational opportunity and social mobility. 

• Received training and support to develop my personal and professional skills as a mentor 
• Helped a class of 25 students prepare for their college application process.
• Prepared and gave lectures to high school students regarding higher education and educational opportunities
